summary: Provides a framework and a template for writing specifications of services that network elements offer to applications in networks with multiple qualities of service. It gives context, definitions and suggested data formats, then sets out the template that service documents should follow.

eli5.summary: It is a fill-in-the-blanks form that anyone describing a new network service should use, so all the descriptions look alike.

questions: how to write a network service specification
what is the intserv service template
